release_notes: Amy FX Pro kini memakai snapshot Amy FX Preview 2.0.0-preview.316 sebagai baseline utama.
Mapping canonical Amy-SMC-D, closed-candle contract, Dealing Range, execution consumers, dan live-price isolation dari Preview 316 dipertahankan.
Branding, version line, repository, dan update channel sudah menjadi Amy FX Pro; package dan URI lineage Preview sementara dipertahankan untuk kompatibilitas Firebase, data aplikasi, dan deep-link.
Update channel Amy FX Pro berada di repo suhaimitoamy/Amy-fx-pro pada branch main.
changelog: Promote Preview 316 codebase as Amy FX Pro main baseline
Amy FX Pro branding and version line
Dedicated Amy FX Pro update channel
Preview package lineage preserved for Firebase and data continuity
